data.text: # Weather Trigger - when its RAIN, then RUN this graph

# What this Graph do:
- Check if a player HAVE Traveler's Clothes
- If he HAVE = Nothing
- If he DONT HAVE = HE have 10% probability to: Take some damage, Get Sick or 90% = nothing. 
- When 10% - DM see a small window, that ASK DM what to do

# This is HP trigger Node 
If HP is lower then X => run this graph (check this node for more info)

# How to use
1) Imagine the following situation: when your SELECTED character's health drops below a certain threshold, they can say something to their friends before they die, to make that moment more epic.

2) You can track boss stages and add effects to the map, spawn tokens, etc.

3) You can set it up so that someone shouts something out when HP drops below X.

# Timer Node
- Use it when you want to make something happen in exact day and exact time

# Example
- In Curse of Strahd you have only X days to save Vallaki. So we created a trigger node "TImer" and when will be the day X you automaticly change Quest Status to FAIL

# Important 
- Don't forget to Turn off this Automation, if you don't want to show it to your players! 
- Open "Timer" node and select "Disabled"
